name: Ring of the Anchor
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 2nd; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of swimming. When the ring is covered with water, however, it becomes a dead weight on the wearer’s hand. The ring adds 50 pounds to the wearer’s carried weight and imparts a -5 penalty to his Swim checks. The extra weight remains in effect for 1d6 minutes after the ring is no longer covered with water.

This ring can only be removed either by the casting of remove curse or keeping the ring covered in holy water for 24 hours. Either method destroys the ring.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of swimming

Identification DC 27
False Identification DC 17
